newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei slips below 19,000, hit by Dow's fall.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei slips below 19,000, hit by Dow's fall.

text.p: The Tokyo stock market's key index slipped below the key 19,000-point level in early morning trade on Monday, jarred by the tumble in Dow industrials on Friday, brokers said.
After the first half hour of trade, the Nikkei 225 average was down 467.64 points, or 2.42 percent, at 18,858.39. Its September futures were down 570 points at 18,870.

"Arbitrageurs sold cash stocks in response to Friday's weak closing of the Nikkei 225 futures in Chicago which was caused by the sharp fall in New York stocks," said an analyst at a major Japanese brokerage.
On Friday, the Dow tumbled 247.37 points to 7,694.66, its second-biggest point drop ever.
